name: rock_band
character: drum kit, bass and guitars with a vocal or lead line; riffs repeat on purpose and the energy comes from the band entering and leaving
why: a shipped starting point for `gate_profiles.py new <name> --from rock_band`: the figures are starting values chosen for the genre structure, not measurements of a piece; measure with scripts/rca.py and state the real figures in the project profile

pattern.loop_short.reason: a riff and a locked kit repeat; sections change by parts entering and fills, so 6 % of the bars differing is the floor

pattern.drums_few.reason: a backbeat repeats; fills and crashes at section changes carry the variety

pattern.velocity_flat.reason: a played kit and distorted guitars sit near the top of the range; accents are 20-40 % but the spread is narrow in absolute terms
